name: The Freelancer Stack
tagline: Run your entire solo business with AI — from writing to invoicing
description: Whether you're a writer, designer, consultant, or developer, these four tools cover every part of running a solo business: creating content, communicating with clients, managing your time, and getting paid.

name: The E-commerce Stack
tagline: Drive more traffic, convert more customers, and automate your store
description: This stack gives e-commerce owners AI superpowers for content, SEO, customer relationships, and workflow automation — the four pillars of a growing online store.

name: The Agency Stack
tagline: Deliver more client work in less time without hiring more people
description: Agencies live and die by output speed and quality. This stack covers content creation at scale, SEO deliverables, video production, and project coordination — everything you need to handle more clients without burning out.

name: The Local Business Stack
tagline: Serve more customers and cut admin time for your local business
description: Restaurants, salons, gyms, and other local businesses spend too much time on admin and customer communication. This stack automates follow-ups, organises your customer base, and handles billing — so you can focus on what you do best.

name: The SaaS Startup Stack
tagline: Build, grow, and support your SaaS with a lean AI-powered team
description: Early-stage SaaS teams need to do everything with few people. This stack covers internal knowledge management, CRM, project tracking, async communication, and automation — the five tools that let a team of 3 operate like a team of 10.
